title: The DPP System Standards Are Here: A Field Guide to CEN/CENELEC JTC 24's Eight Standards
subtitle: What EN 18216 through EN 18246 actually govern — the horizontal identity, interoperability and security layer beneath every EU Digital Product Passport.
featuredImageAlt: A colorful low-poly illustration of many floating octahedra of varying sizes connected into a network on a pale sky, in Regen Studio's triangular-polygon style — the Digital Product Passport system standards as a shared, interoperable ecosystem
excerpt: In 2026, CEN/CENELEC finalised eight European Standards — the EN 1821x series — that define how every EU Digital Product Passport is identified, carried, exchanged, stored, secured and authenticated. Here is what each standard does, how they fit together, and what they mean if you place products on the EU market.
